copy_snapshot.evidence: Outward symlink and symlinked parent attacks reject rc13; in-root symlink is disclosed; hardlink is accepted and disclosed via nlink.

revision_hash_pair.evidence: Manifest binds HEAD role, verifier input, raw pre/post/copy hashes, normalized hashes, realpath/symlink metadata, and self-digest.

copy_based_arms.evidence: Arms 12-17 cover outward symlink, forced provenance, predicate correction, parent symlink, hardlink disclosure, and in-root symlink disclosure; prior arms remain present.

verifier_transient_unstable.evidence: Verifier-owned bounded capture, rc10/no-verdict, forced-dirty refusal, and saved movement provenance.

remaining_scope.hardlinks: Accepted as in-root byte identity, disclosed via nlink; not treated as a containment escape.
remaining_scope.in_root_symlink: Allowed but disclosed with source_realpath/is_symlink; this is a declared policy choice, not hidden equivalence.
remaining_scope.source_head: Provenance only, not verdict input; verifier identity and file hashes remain binding.

promotion_boundary: The four Q97 conditions are met for the declared link policy. Promotion still means foundation-stage review, not commit-hook wiring; the implementation must retain the 14-arm selftest and the explicit hardlink/in-root-symlink semantics.
no_claim: No claim that hardlinks are rejected, no claim that an in-root symlink is equivalent to a regular file, and no commit-hook promotion.
